description: DevBench style (spec to working software): build a small Node HTTP service from a written endpoint specification. The spec has the details that separate a careful reading from a sketch - ETag and If-Match optimistic concurrency with a fixed order of checks (404 before 428 before 412 before body validation), filter-before-paging cursor pagination where next_cursor appears only when more matching items remain, exact Allow headers, and independent state per createServer() call. The protected tests start the server in-process on an ephemeral port and the post-turn verifier gives a repair round.
